## Fishery Stability: Discussion

-   Feedback from social scientists & councils to focus on
    -   Volatility - how much do fishery landings/profits/effort fluctuate year to year?
    -   Adaptive Capacity - how well can fishery participants adapt to change?
-   Do our indicators address this definition?
-   Are there others used elsewhere that are useful?

## Ecosystem Stability: Discussion

::::: soe-50-50-slide
::: soe-50-column
In 2026 we move from increasing/decreasing stability to stable/not-stable

"Not-stable" doesn't mean:

-   we are experiencing a regime shift necessarily
-   we are experiencing negative impacts

"Stable" doesn't mean:

-   There are no changes in the system
-   All is well
:::

::: soe-50-column
"Not Stable" does mean:

-   There are large changes in multiple ecosystem components
-   These changes are altering the structure or function of the ecosystem
:::
:::::
